evidence: I6 (RUNTIME IS VENDOR-NEUTRAL): no model names anywhere in framework files. Use capability descriptors only. Valid descriptors: code-generation, analysis, synthesis, long-context, reasoning, instruction-following, tool-use, vision, embedding. Invalid: any model name, provider name, version string (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, etc.). runtime-state.json uses capability descriptors with confidence scores — never model IDs. routing receipt uses selected_capability (descriptor) not model name. ContextTuner parameters are generic API fields (temperature, top_p, top_k) — not model-specific. InferenceGuard: no model names in receipt or trigger vocabulary. Violations: I6_VIOLATION error type, HARD severity. Applies to all 100 modules, all shared references, all scripts.
